settings.repere: Titre H2 · Independently tested. For your peace of
settings.text: Independently tested. For your peace of mind.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · We set the bar for quality, and keep rai
settings.text: We set the bar for quality, and keep raising it. From formulation and sourcing to manufacturing and testing, every chew is made in a BRCS-certificated facility so it’s safe, effective and consistent, batch after batch.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · The BRCGS Food Safety Global Standard is
settings.text: The BRCGS Food Safety Global Standard is the most widely accepted food safety standard in the world, a framework for managing product safety, integrity, legality and quality. Our manufacturing site is audited against it every year.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Effectiveness can vary based on not only
settings.text: Effectiveness can vary based on not only the ingredients, but also the formulation: the quantity of each ingredient, how they are paired, and how they are manufactured. That is the part our vets work on.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Every active goes in at the level the st
settings.text: Every active goes in at the level the studies actually used, not a trace amount that reads well on a label.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · No artificial flavourings, no colourings
settings.text: No artificial flavourings, no colourings, no wheat or grains. Whole-food ingredients you could pronounce.
